insights.one_liner: Cboe is a Chicago-based exchange operator for options, futures, FX and digital assets, with a senior software role open in Amsterdam.

culture.text: About 1,645 people on LinkedIn; the biggest functions are engineering, IT, business development and finance.
Staff mostly studied computer science, finance and economics, many at US universities like Chicago and Illinois.
Describes its people as solving complex challenges together while building financial market infrastructure.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, a senior software engineering role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.
That role drew an average of 93 applicants on LinkedIn.

growth.text: Extended its S&P 500 options licence with S&P Dow Jones Indices through 2051.
Plans new KPI contracts with Robinhood, expanding its prediction market products.
Is exploring perpetual futures on the VIX volatility index.

worth_knowing.text: Same-day S&P 500 contracts hit a monthly record of 3.4 million a day on average at Cboe.
